ownership_review: PendingWrite stack registration occurs only under Track mutex before the real CV wait; wait reacquires that mutex before RAII unlinks.
Mixer copies only genuine live input through the existing capacity-limited ring and accounts committed bytes once per writer.
Pause/Stop/Release epochs and frozen stop_end reject stale borrowed suffixes; no new source is admitted while stopping.
JNI array/direct-buffer references and shared Track owner remain live throughout WriteBytes; existing nonblocking AAudio/OpenSL paths do not register borrowed data.
Completed and cancelled records unlink before caller input can retire; real cancellation and concurrent Release are tested.
FIFO describes currently registered records, not a new global ordering promise across all Write calls.
limits: Host executes complete production Track/PCM/ring/resampler plus actual CaptureSink and Analyze sections; Engine attachment, clock transport and CV scheduling are explicit boundaries.
Deterministic catch-up reproduces a sufficient real 446-frame gap mechanism, not the archived Windows scheduler.
No actual Windows device, WASAPI, ART/JNI or whole process performance claim from this replay.
